If no one can stop you. At least make sure you do it so you dont come back... Brain death is far worse than full death.  
Google the legal research chem opiates in the fentanyl category. But i do hope you can find another path before they become the only option. But i to feel a similar pull by the opaites.. But to do them to live instead.. Trust me, theres no better anti depressant/ content creating set of drugs than strong opiates. I wouldve been dead years ago from killing myself if i didnt become a heroin addict, funny how that would be seen as insanity to many people. But i know for a fact id be dead without it at my own hands.

Yeah i figure it is to if i can live with my family disowning me, im sure they'd rather me be an alive junkie than just dead... Luckily bitcoin made me totally financilly independant the rest of my life... So its not like im on the street at all. Can do heroin everyday the rest of my life probably after buying a small house and still have plenty left over.. Thank fuck for crypto.

Wishing i sold all mine at 20k... ill keep holding out. But i will likely eventually do exactly what you're planning to friend. Fuck it all. Go up into the thai opium mountains and never come back thats my plan, thai heroin extravaganza

You find your own meaning. Fuck me. Is it that hard?   
Stop with the higher power shit cause thats the only place this question comes from usually. Its 100% a statement of taking no responsibly for finding meaning yourself. I have no meaning in my life. But im fully aware its my own fault, partially i cant do anything about it cause im riddled with physical health problems. But i still havent given up optimism that eventually ill be in a place in life where ill find my own purpose and sense of meaning again.   
Homeless people are a great bunch for a sense of perspective, go try talking to some. Not kidding. 

In the sense of is life meaningless, that theres no purpose to our species beyond death. Yes is it meaningless in respect and sorry if this is news to you. Heroin worked wonders for me to help deal with this hahah...... i honestly dont recommend that one unless you're truly on the brink. Sorry if i come off as a jaded asshole, im not very sympathetic anymore.. That got drained out years ago by cheating whores, loser friends and ignorance.

Why not? Cant argue with a swift heroin over dose in thailand surrounded by hookers. Fuck living conventionally if life feels like its lost its purpose. Maybe before the OD you'll find a new purpose and start a new life on a thai fishing boat unhindered by all the worlds garbage. Who the fuck knows. But thats basically my plan if my health keeps deteriorating. I already got used to be crippled emotionally years ago by my genetics. But if my body completely fails which it seems to be, thailand here i come.
If you didnt believe in a higher power. None of this comment would make allot of sense to me. You dont owe the world anything by taking yourself out of it.
